plagiarism.title: Plagiarism check

methodDescriptions.tree-sitter: Parse C++ syntax to compare code tokens and syntax trees. Parse errors are flagged for review.
methodDescriptions.heuristic: Compare code tokens and infer statement structure with the original heuristic checker.

plagiarism.description: After the contest ends, compare each participant's latest C++ submission for each problem. Checks run in the background and keep their results when you leave this page.
plagiarism.afterEnd: Available after the contest ends on {end}.
plagiarism.background: You can leave this page and return to follow the check.
plagiarism.notRun: No plagiarism check has been run for this contest.
plagiarism.loadFailed: Could not load the check. Reload to try again.
plagiarism.pollFailed: Could not update progress. Reload to reconnect to the check.
plagiarism.startFailed: Could not start the check. Try again.
plagiarism.taskFailed: The check could not finish. Run it again to retry.
plagiarism.reviewNotice: Similarity is a signal for review, not proof of plagiarism. Shared algorithms, standard templates, and short solutions can produce high scores. Review both sources and contest context before making a decision.
plagiarism.shown: {count, plural, one {# pair shown} other {# pairs shown}}
plagiarism.noPairs: No comparable pairs. Each problem needs C++ submissions from at least two participants.
plagiarism.noFilteredPairs: No pairs match these filters. Lower the minimum similarity or select another problem.
plagiarism.limitations: Only the latest eligible C++ submission for each participant and problem is compared, and comparisons stay within the same problem. Comments and names are normalized; reordered blocks and extracted functions are considered. The check cannot prove that two programs have the same meaning or detect every rewrite.
plagiarism.evidenceNotice: Highlighted lines show matching code fragments. Structural similarity can remain high even without a continuous matching fragment. Select a range to jump to both locations.
plagiarism.matches: {count, plural, one {# matching fragment} other {# matching fragments}}
plagiarism.noMatches: No continuous matching fragments were found. Inspect the structure and the complete sources.
plagiarism.sourceFailed: Could not load both sources. Try again.

explanations.emptySource: Source code is empty or unavailable.
explanations.sourceLimit: Source code exceeds the 64 KiB analysis limit.
explanations.storedSourceUnreadable: Stored source code could not be read.
explanations.engineByteLimit: Source code exceeds the engine's 256 KiB limit.
explanations.tokenLimit: Source code exceeds the 30,000 token limit.
explanations.pairTimeout: A source or comparison exceeded its ten-second time limit.
explanations.contestTimeout: The check exceeded its five-minute time limit. Run it again to retry.
explanations.problemLimit: Plagiarism checks support contests with at most four problems.
explanations.participantLimit: Plagiarism checks support contests with at most 20 participants.
explanations.reportLimit: The similarity report exceeded the storage limit.

warnings.tree-sitter-parse-errors: Tree-sitter could not fully parse this code. The comparison uses the recovered syntax tree; inspect the source carefully.
warnings.short-source: Short submissions provide limited evidence; similar templates can dominate the score.
warnings.preprocessor-not-expanded: Preprocessor macros are compared as written; expanded code may differ.
warnings.incomplete-comment: A source contains an incomplete comment; the comparison may miss part of the code.
warnings.incomplete-raw-string: A source contains an incomplete raw string; review the source carefully.
warnings.incomplete-string: A source contains an incomplete string; review the source carefully.
warnings.unused-scalar-ignored: Unused scalar declarations were omitted from the comparison.
warnings.evidence-regions-limited: Only the 100 largest matching fragments are shown.
